verdict.rationale: Orama's docs explicitly describe hybrid search as combining full-text and vector search in a single query ('perform full-text and vector search in one unique query, combining the results'), and this is corroborated by feature listings on GitHub and Cloud docs listing Full-Text/Vector/Hybrid search as core modes. missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmark or third-party verification specifically of hybrid query fusion (the probe only tests keyword search, not hybrid).
